overview.title: Overview
overview.intro: This dashboard is the foundation for managing the Chief Harena website and event inquiries. Modules appear below as they are built; each one is shown only to roles that may use it.
overview.noModules: No modules are available for your role yet.

Auth.loginSubtitle: Staff access to the Chief Harena admin.
Auth.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
Auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
Auth.noPublicSignup: Staff accounts are created by the owner. There is no public registration.
Auth.configRequiredBody: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in .env.local, then restart the server. The README explains local setup.
Auth.accessDeniedTitle: You don't have access to this area
Auth.accessDeniedBody: You are signed in, but your account has no staff role that allows this. Ask the owner to grant access.
